It requires a prompt. It is not made to generate spoken words. 143: 144: - **More Plugins Types: Temporal Upsamplers / Audio Processors**: you can now add your own Temporal Upsampler (*Rife* alternative) or *Audio Processor* (*MMAudio* alternative). As a reminder the previous version allowed already to add a custom *Spatial Upsampler*. 145: 146: - **API+, MCP+.**: I have improved the API capabilties (please check *docs/API.md*), and widened *MCP* support. Feel free to share feedback on Discord 147: 148: - **Finetune Resolutions**: define custom resolutions directly in finetunes 149: 150: *Update 12.25*: Ideograms v4 Turbo Time, MSR t2i, Scail2 parallel subwindows\ 151: *Update 12.26*: LTX2 inpainting & ingredients, Easy cap, Scail2 fix\ 152: *Update 12.27*: KREA2, Scail2 multiref 153: 154: 155: ### 14th of June 2026: WanGP v12.22, Go with the Flow 156: - **Media Flow Plugin**: the *Full Video Process* is now named *Media Flow* because it can process *Images* as well as *Videos*. Even better, the new *Batch* mode can process any number of files: for instance, give *Media Flow* the path to the folder containing your collection of butterfly pictures and *all the corresponding images will be upsampled in one click*! 157: 158: - **Scail 2**: the sequel to one of the best video *Character Animators*, and a very good alternative to *Wan 2.2 Animate*. You can either *Animate* up to 5 people by providing a *Start Image* and a *Control Video* that contains the movement, or *Replace* one person in an existing Control Video. Animate mode preserves identity well thanks to the new *Reference Image* input and, best of all, it supports *Sliding Windows* for non-stop dancing! 159: 160: Please note that Scail 2 *Replace* and *Animate* modes require colored masks if more than two people are being replaced or animated. You can build them easily with *WanGP Magic Mask* (remember the magic wand icon). Also, for best results, I recommend using a *Reference Image* or a *Start Image* that is closely aligned to the first frame of the control video; you can use an *Image Model* generator for this. 161: 162: Version *update 12.21* introduces RAM optimisations when using many *sliding windows* and added support for *Lora accelerator lightx2v 4 steps* 163: 164: - **Int8 ConvRot Support**: model checkpoints saved in this quantized int8 format used by Comfy can now be loaded in WanGP. 165: 166: - **LTX2 Image Generator (t2i)**: this one was always within grasp but required a little bit of packaging. Here we go we, just pick the *text to image* tab and use *LTX2* to use your favorite *Ic LoRAs* (outpainting, refiner, ...) on *images*. Best of all, the *LTX2 Image Processes* are available in the *Media Flow* Plugin. 167: 168: - **Bernini 1.3B**: a much more gentle version (*lower VRAM requirements and faster*) for your GPU. Not as good as the 14GB version, but still produces some nice outputs. 169: 170: - **Chain of Zoom Upsampler**: new upsampler that can magnify up to x16, quite good with hair and skin. However it expects low quality image so it may reinvent existing details. WanGP optimized: low VRAM and up to x4 times faster 171: 172: - **Upsampler & Model Plugins**: PlugIn developers can now create plugins that add new *Spatial Upsampler* or new *Models* 173: 174: As sample plugins, enjoy: 175: - **Stable Diffusion 1.4**: the father of all image generators ! 176: - **Pixel Upsampler**: upsample by duplicating the same pixel for a grandiose Pixel Art effect ! 177: 178: *update 12.21*: Scail 2 RAM optim + lightx2v support, added LTX2 t2v & Bernini 1.3B\ 179: *update 12.22*: Chain of Zoom Upsampler, Upsampler & Model Plugins 180: 181: ### 7th of June 2026: WanGP v12.13, Prompt Control 182: - **Ideogram 4 Prompt Helper**: the great thing about Ideogram 4 is that you can position every object or text exactly where you expect it in your output image. Ideogram 4 now has a *Visual Helper* to create and edit its JSON prompt format. Click the *Magic Wand* next to the prompt to draw or resize text/object boxes, tune the main prompt fields, and apply the final JSON back to the prompt. *Magic Prompt* can still create the first draft for you. 183: 184: - **JoyAI-Echo**: this new LTX-2.3 model is the closest thing to *SeeDance 2* that you may find in the open source world. It is an audio-video model for connected multi-window stories. JoyAI-Echo keeps compact memories between windows so later shots can reuse characters, voices, objects, and places. WanGP implementation of *JoyAI-Echo* goes well beyond the original implementation: 185: - With the new *Sliding Window commands* (see below), you can extend existing *Sliding Windows*, *Create New Shots*, or *Continue a Video*. 186: - The new memory command system (`[/store_mem]`, `[/load_mem]`, and `[/drop_mem]`) lets you pick which sliding windows can be reused for future memory and which ones should no longer be used. Please check the JoyAI-Echo *Prompt help* for the full syntax. 187: - Use a *Control Video* to target audio/video segments in the *Joy Memory Positions* field and seed the first memories with characters and background. 188: For instance *Joy Memory Positions* could be `man=4s,woman=12s`, if a man is speaking at around 4s and a woman at around 12s. The two memories can be used in later windows with the command [/load_mem=man] or [/load_mem=woman] 189: 190: - **Sliding Window Commands**: thanks to new inline prompt commands (for instance `[/duration=...]`, `[/overlap=...]`, and `[/new_shot]`), you can now define a different duration, number of frames, or transition style on a per-window basis. You can also change the LoRAs multipliers of the current window with `[/loras_mult=1;0]`. See `docs/PROMPTS.md` for the full syntax and examples. 191: 192: ### 4th of June 2026: WanGP v12.00, The Journey Continues 193: - **PiD**: a new high quality x4 spatial upsampler for images by Nvidia. It is supposed to work with only Flux/Flux2 compatible models since it needs to plug directly to the VAE Decoder. However thanks to a simple trick it is available everywhere. Some automated Tiling may be triggered if you ask for very high out res. WanGP version is as usual ultra optimized and should require little VRAM even when tiling is not used. 194: 195: - **Ideograms v4**: this image generator claims to be the best open source image generator. It consumes a special *Json Prompt Format* that WanGP *Prompt Enhancer* can produce for you. There is a snag though: occasionnaly, even a harmless prompt may trigger a *Safety Filter*. No way to get around this as it is hardcoded in the model weights. 196: 197: - **Stable Audio 3**: WanGP *Text To Speech* (TTS) collection of models is now completed with a model that can generate sounds, background music or special effects 198: 199: - **Bernini 14B**: the video model derived from Wan 2.2 is really incredible. You can ask it to modify the content of an existing video or to generate a new video with any number of *References Images*. and *it just works*. There is a price to pay though: to generate 81 frames, you will need 12 GB of VRAM for *v2v* / 16GB for *v2v + ref frames*. v2v works quite well with Lora Accelerators such as *lightning 4 steps* . But as soon as you include reference frames, you will have to go for at least 15 steps with guidance and no lora accelerator. You are not allowed to complain, this model is advertised to work on a H100 and thanks to WanGP magic you can run it at home. 200: 201: - **MCP Server & Agent Skills**: WanGP includes now a *MCP server* to make life much easier to your AI Agents. WanGP exposes also new discovery functions that can be queried by to agent to get the list of all generative models and features that are available. 202: 203: ### 1st of June 2026: WanGP v11.90, Everything will be fine... 204: **Finetune Creator / Editor** 205: *Create* a new *Finetune* (use an existing model with your own checkpoints), *Edit* or *Import* an existing Finetune in only one click directly from the *WanGP UI*. You can then share easily a finetune with other users by clicking the *Export* button. 206: 207: Look for the new **+** in the *WanGP Tool Bar*. 208: 209: The finetune creator allows you not only to customize an existing models with *Custom URLs* or *Local Paths* for both the main *Transformer files* & *Text encoders* but also to define *User help* and set *Custom System Templates* to be used with the finetune *Prompt Enhancer*. 210: 211: Please check *docs/FINETUNE.md* doc for info about finetunes. 212: 213: ### 29th of May 2026: WanGP v11.88, Humans Accelerators 214: - **Create Hierarchies of Loras / Change Order of Loras** 215: 216: - **WanGP Toolbar** with keyboard shortcuts: 217: - **Search**: switch quickly to another model by just entering a few letters of its name 218: - **Refresh Model List**: no longer needed to restart the app to add or modify a finetune 219: - **Unload All**: free most of the RAM/VRAM used by WanGP 220: 221: - **MOV/MKV Container Support**: beside *mp4* files you can now store you video gens in *mov* and *mkv* containers 222: 223: - **ProRes422 & DNxHR HQ Video Codecs**: these professional video codecs have some fans out there 224: 225: - **LTX-2 Guide**: click the "i" to the right of the model description to get tips / explanations on how to use LTX2 models 226: 227: - **LTX2 Smearing Fix**: the smearing / ghosting is now mostly gone 228: 229: - **Omnivoice Fix**: you will enjoy this fix unless you liked the gibberish generator of the previous version 230: 231: 232: 233: 234: See full changelog: **[Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md)** 235: 236: 237: ## 🚀 Quick Start 238: 239: ### One-click Bat/SH Script Auto-installer: 240: 241: The 1-click automated scripts for both **Windows (`.bat`)** and **Linux/macOS (`.sh`)** make installation, environment management, and updates as seamless as possible. These scripts will not only install WanGP but also best acceleration kernels (Triton, Sage, Flash, GGuf, Lightx2v, Nunchaku) available for your config. 242: 243: *👉 **Windows Users:** Double-click the `.bat` files. **Linux Users:** Run the `.sh` files in your terminal.* 244: 245: #### **1️⃣ Installation (`scripts\install.bat` | `scripts/install.sh`)** 246: 247: **Choose Installation Type** 248: - **Auto Install** 249: - **Manual Install** 250: 251: **Manual Install** 252: 253: If you selected Manual Install, you will be guided through: 254: 255: 1. **Choose your package manager** 256: 2. **Name your environment** 257: 3. **Select your Install Mode** 258: 259: #### 2️⃣ Starting the App (`scripts\run.bat` | `scripts/run.sh`) 260: Once installed, use this script to launch the application. It runs WAN2GP using your active environment. 261: 262: * **⚙️ Customizing Launch Arguments (`args.txt`)** 263: * If you want to pass extra command-line flags to the launcher (like enabling advanced UI features or automatically opening your browser), create an `args.txt` file in your `scripts` folder. 264: * **Example `args.txt`:** 265: ```text 266: --advanced --open-browser 267: ``` 268: 269: #### 3️⃣ Updating & Upgrading (`scripts\update.bat` | `scripts/update.sh`) 270: Use this script to get the latest updates for WAN2GP and upgrade dependencies. 271: * **1. Update:** Fetches the latest code from GitHub and updates requirements. 272: * **2. Upgrade:** Allows you to manually individually upgrade heavy backend components (like PyTorch, Triton, Sage Attention). 273: 274: #### 4️⃣ Managing Environments (`scripts\manage.bat` | `scripts/manage.sh`) 275: Use this script to manage and switch between your sandboxed environments safely. 276: 277: * **Example Scenario 1: Migrating an Existing Setup** 278: * If you have a folder named `venv` that works perfectly and want to use it with the new one-click scripts, run `manage.bat` and select **Add Existing Environment**. 279: * Copy-paste the folder path (e.g., `C:\WAN2GP\venv`), select type `venv`, then use **Set Active Environment** to make it the default. Now `run.bat` and `update.bat` will target your existing setup. 280: 281: * **Example Scenario 2: Testing New Configurations** 282: * Let's say you have an environment named `env_stable` that works perfectly, but you want to try the new "Use Latest" combo. ### What the project does:
The project is called **WanGP** (formerly/also known as Wan2GP). It is described as a "one-stop super app for the best open source generative models across video, image, audio, and text-to-speech." 
Yes, it is definitely related to **Wan 2.1** video generation! It supports a wide array of models including:
- **Video:** Wan 2.1/2.2, LTX-2, Hunyuan Video 1/1.5, LongCat, Kandinsky, and more.
- **Image:** Qwen Image, Z-Image, Flux 1/2, HiDream.
- **Audio/TTS:** Qwen3 TTS, Ace Step, Stable Audio 3, etc.

It includes features tailored for local execution on a wide range of hardware ("accessible to the GPU poor"), including low VRAM requirements (down to 6 GB), support for older Nvidia GPUs (GTX 10XX series and up), and AMD GPUs. It provides a full web UI, queue management, LoRA support, video masking/upsampling, and built-in AI agents for automating tedious tasks.

### Can it generate a video locally without paid API keys?
**Yes, absolutely.** The project is entirely designed to run these models locally on your own hardware (via Python/Conda or Docker). The README explicitly states: 
> "**WanGP is free to use locally.** The official project will never ask you to pay a license fee, subscription, or donation to run WanGP on your own computer..."

Since it runs open-source models directly on your GPU, there are no API keys or paid subscriptions required to generate videos.
